notebooks.title: 加权面积与变换表
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', positive=True)
s = sp.symbols('s')
w = sp.symbols('w', positive=True)

cells.code:
for f in [sp.Integer(1),t,t**2,sp.exp(-t),sp.sin(w*t),sp.cos(w*t)]:
    print('函数/变换/收敛界:',f,sp.laplace_transform(f,t,s))
finite = sp.integrate(sp.exp(-t),(t,0,4))
tail = sp.integrate(sp.exp(-t),(t,4,sp.oo))
print('默认有限/尾项/总量:',finite,tail,sp.simplify(finite+tail))
print('默认近似:',sp.N(finite,12),sp.N(tail,12))
print('边界r0前4分钟:',sp.integrate(sp.Integer(1),(t,0,4)))
negative = sp.integrate(sp.exp(t/4),(t,0,4))
print('不收敛例前4分钟:',negative,sp.N(negative,12))

notebooks.title: 移位与导数规则
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', positive=True)
s = sp.symbols('s')

cells.code:
F = sp.laplace_transform(sp.exp(-t),t,s,noconds=True)
first = sp.laplace_transform(-sp.exp(-t),t,s,noconds=True)
shifted = sp.laplace_transform(t*sp.exp(-t),t,s)
print('指数移位:',shifted)
print('导数直接/带初值/余量:',first,sp.simplify(s*F-1),sp.simplify(first-(s*F-1)))
f = t*sp.exp(-t)
F2 = sp.laplace_transform(f,t,s,noconds=True)
rule = s*s*F2-sp.limit(f,t,0,dir='+')*s-sp.limit(sp.diff(f,t),t,0,dir='+')
direct = sp.laplace_transform(sp.diff(f,t,2),t,s,noconds=True)
print('二阶初值:',sp.limit(f,t,0,dir='+'),sp.limit(sp.diff(f,t),t,0,dir='+'))
print('二阶直接/规则/余量:',direct,sp.simplify(rule),sp.simplify(direct-rule))

notebooks.title: 初值问题与部分分式
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', positive=True)
s = sp.symbols('s')

cells.code:
Y0 = 1/(s*(s+1))
Y2 = (1/s+2)/(s+1)
Ysecond = 1/(s*(s+1)**2)
y0 = sp.inverse_laplace_transform(Y0,s,t)
y2 = sp.inverse_laplace_transform(Y2,s,t)
ysecond = sp.inverse_laplace_transform(Ysecond,s,t)
print('一阶零初值:',sp.apart(Y0,s),y0)
print('一阶初值/余量:',sp.limit(y0,t,0,dir='+'),sp.limit(y2,t,0,dir='+'),sp.simplify(sp.diff(y0,t)+y0-1),sp.simplify(sp.diff(y2,t)+y2-1))
print('一阶非零初值:',sp.apart(Y2,s),y2,'ln2时:',sp.simplify(y2.subs(t,sp.log(2))))
print('二阶分式/解:',sp.apart(Ysecond,s),ysecond)
print('二阶方程余量/初值:',sp.simplify(sp.diff(ysecond,t,2)+2*sp.diff(ysecond,t)+ysecond-1),sp.limit(ysecond,t,0,dir='+'),sp.limit(sp.diff(ysecond,t),t,0,dir='+'))
print('二阶ln2时:',sp.simplify(ysecond.subs(t,sp.log(2))),sp.N(ysecond.subs(t,sp.log(2)),12))
print('二次分母反变换:',sp.inverse_laplace_transform(2/(s*s+4),s,t))

notebooks.title: 延迟的时间含义
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', nonnegative=True)
s = sp.symbols('s')
r = sp.symbols('r', positive=True)

cells.code:
base,roc,condition = sp.laplace_transform(1-sp.exp(-r),r,s)
delayed = sp.exp(-2*s)*base
print('延迟变换/ROC界/条件:',sp.factor(delayed),roc,condition)
g = sp.Piecewise((0,t<2),(1-sp.exp(-(t-2)),True))
for q in [1,2,3]:
    print('时刻/输出:',q,g.subs(t,q),sp.N(g.subs(t,q),12))
print('原响应变换与ROC:',sp.laplace_transform(1-sp.exp(-r),r,s))

notebooks.title: 卷积与输入累积
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', positive=True)
r = sp.symbols('r', real=True)
s = sp.symbols('s')

cells.code:
same = sp.integrate(sp.exp(-(t-r))*sp.exp(-r),(r,0,t))
step = sp.integrate(sp.exp(-(t-r)),(r,0,t))
print('指数卷积/变换:',same,sp.laplace_transform(same,t,s))
print('常输入卷积/变换:',step,sp.laplace_transform(step,t,s))
print('乘法核验:',sp.simplify(sp.laplace_transform(same,t,s,noconds=True)-1/(s+1)**2))

notebooks.title: 传递函数与初终值检查
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', positive=True)
s = sp.symbols('s')

cells.code:
G = 2/(s+1)
Y = G/s + 3/(s+1)
y = sp.inverse_laplace_transform(Y,s,t)
print('带初值输出/ln2时:',y,sp.simplify(y.subs(t,sp.log(2))))
print('方程余量/初值:',sp.simplify(sp.diff(y,t)+y-2),sp.limit(y,t,0,dir='+'))
zero_part = sp.inverse_laplace_transform(G/s,s,t)
print('零初值部分/漏项/极点:',zero_part,sp.simplify(y-zero_part),sp.solve(sp.denom(G),s))
Ystep = 1/(s*(s+1))
print('合法初值/终值:',sp.limit(s*Ystep,s,sp.oo),sp.limit(s*Ystep,s,0,dir='+'))
for F in [1/(s*s+1),1/(s-1)]:
    reduced = sp.cancel(s*F)
    print('形式终值/极点:',sp.limit(reduced,s,0,dir='+'),sp.solve(sp.denom(reduced),s))
print('exp(t)变换与ROC:',sp.laplace_transform(sp.exp(t),t,s))

notebooks.title: 六题答案复算
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', positive=True)
s = sp.symbols('s')
r = sp.symbols('r', real=True)

cells.code:
print('题1:',sp.laplace_transform(sp.exp(-t),t,s),sp.integrate(sp.exp(-t),(t,0,4)),sp.integrate(sp.exp(-t),(t,4,sp.oo)))
print('题2:',sp.laplace_transform(t*sp.exp(-2*t),t,s))
Y3 = (1/s+2)/(s+1)
y3 = sp.inverse_laplace_transform(Y3,s,t)
print('题3:',sp.apart(Y3,s),y3,sp.simplify(y3.subs(t,sp.log(2))))
Y4 = 1/(s*(s+1)**2)
y4 = sp.inverse_laplace_transform(Y4,s,t)
print('题4:',sp.apart(Y4,s),y4,sp.simplify(y4.subs(t,sp.log(2))))
print('题5延迟变换/第3分钟:',sp.exp(-2*s)/(s*(s+1)),1-1/sp.E,sp.N(1-1/sp.E,12))
c = sp.integrate(sp.exp(-(t-r))*sp.exp(-r),(r,0,t))
print('题5卷积/变换:',c,sp.laplace_transform(c,t,s))
for F in [1/(s*(s+1)),1/(s*s+1),1/(s-1)]:
    R = sp.cancel(s*F)
    print('题6形式终值/极点:',sp.limit(R,s,0,dir='+'),sp.solve(sp.denom(R),s))
